title: Danger at Deathoak Manor
author: Peter Aperlo
description:
Explore and escape a deadly haunted house in this choose your own adventure bit o' interactive fiction. Perhaps you can quiet the spirits while saving your own life?

There are several ways to survive the game, but none of them is 100% foolproof. Whatever you try, you'll need a little luck in addition to brains.

This is my first "stab" at interactive fiction. What do you think?
